headline: Amber Enterprises India Limited: Issue of Securities
sum: Issue of Securities - Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed you that the Board of Directors of IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited, a material subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited, has approved the raise of…
detail: Issue of Securities - Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed you that the Board of Directors of IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited, a material subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited, has approved the raise of additional capital aggregating to Rs. 3,28,12,28,750/- by way of a Rights Issue of equity shares.

sources.name: NSE filing - Amber Enterprises India Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
